source: Built from https://agenticdevelopment.ai/stages.html on 2026-10-31, until standards/stages.json lands in CommonAgent/adlc.

stages.name: Requirements
stages.role: spec writer for an agent; solution planner for a solution
stages.given: somebody's account of what they want, with whatever they have
stages.hands_back: a statement of the job: what it does, refuses, needs, records and costs, plus the open questions
stages.done_when: a package could be built from it, and nothing unsettled was invented

stages.name: Architecture and Design
stages.role: Architecture: solution architect, or a person. Design: spec writer for an agent; solution planner for a solution
stages.given: Architecture: the statement of the job, and the organization's stack. Design: the statement, and the architecture record
stages.hands_back: Architecture: an architecture record: the systems the agent reaches, in plain words (database, files, text reasoning, mail sender); the product bound to each in dev, test and production: the organization's stack first, a platform default for the rest; dependencies on other agents and services; the agent's kind: a harness reading skills, code that speaks the network itself, or a container; limits on cost, speed, data and trust; each decision, with its reason. Design: the steps, what each is given and hands back, and whether each is a program or a judgment
stages.done_when: every system is named and bound in each environment it will run in, every decision has a reason, and every design step uses only systems the architecture named

stages.name: Impact
stages.given: the change, the running version, and what depends on it
stages.hands_back: the impact report: each dependent marked compatible, breaking or a change of behavior
stages.done_when: every dependent is named and answered, and the person approves before anything is built

stages.name: Source
stages.given: the steps, each with what it takes and hands back
stages.hands_back: for each step, an agent or solution that fits, or "build one" with the reason
stages.done_when: every step has an answer, and every "build one" says why

stages.name: Test
stages.given: the statement of the job
stages.hands_back: the suite, and what no test could be written for
stages.done_when: the suite fails against empty stand-ins, and notices each program removed

stages.name: Code
stages.role: code writer: the reference agent, your own coding agent, or a person
stages.given: the statement, the suite, and a prototype if there is one, as a build folder on a branch with a "Write the scripts" pull request
stages.hands_back: the programs, an account of what was written, and a record of every round
stages.done_when: the suite passes, each program removed is noticed, and the tests and statement are unchanged

stages.name: Review
stages.given: the programs, the tests, and the Code stage's account
stages.hands_back: findings, each naming a place, a claim and a consequence
stages.done_when: every finding is answered, by a change or a reason

stages.name: Security review
stages.given: the architecture record and the design, the programs, and everything the package will ask for
stages.hands_back: what it may reach, what it may spend, what it must never do, and the reason for each
stages.done_when: every permission asked for has a recorded reason

stages.name: Package
stages.given: the architecture record, the design and the programs
stages.hands_back: the package: the declaration (agent-descriptor.json and agent-runtime-requirements.json), the parts, a manifest and a digest
stages.done_when: the declaration validates and matches the runtime requirements, and every program in the package is listed in its manifest

stages.name: Release
stages.given: the package
stages.hands_back: a signed build record, and the package at an address
stages.done_when: the digest at the address matches the record, and the record verifies

stages.name: Deploy
stages.given: the package, where it goes, and the owner's answers as names and numbers
stages.hands_back: a running agent with an identity, an address and an inbox; its Descriptor signed and registered; settings, credentials (placed by name) and ceilings in place before it starts; a signed deployment record
stages.done_when: nothing asked for is missing, no secret appeared, a message gets an answer, and the record is signed
stages.asset: Signed Descriptor and registration, and signed deployment record

stages.name: Conformance
stages.given: the package, the agent's address, and its records
stages.hands_back: a signed verdict, case by case
stages.done_when: every case from the declaration ran, and the verdict is signed

stages.name: Acceptance
stages.role: the requester, the person who asked
stages.given: what was delivered, and "done" as written at Requirements
stages.hands_back: a recorded yes against "done", or a no that says what's missing
stages.done_when: the answer is recorded with who and when, and the request closes

stages.name: Docs
stages.role: documenter for the AgentDoc; doc writer for the documentation
stages.given: the declaration, the identity, and any records and verdicts
stages.hands_back: the AgentDoc a stranger reads, each claim traced to its source, and documentation for people
stages.done_when: nothing in the AgentDoc was authored, and every silence shows

stages.name: Publish
stages.given: the deliverable, and where it may be written
stages.hands_back: an address a person can open, and the digest of what's there
stages.done_when: the address resolves and serves what the digest says

stages.name: Retract
stages.given: the address, or the name it went out under
stages.hands_back: a record of what was taken down, by whom, and when
stages.done_when: the address reads back empty, and the record says why

stages.name: Monitor
stages.given: the fleet, and what each agent declared
stages.hands_back: whether each agent is alive, answering, and inside its limits
stages.done_when: each agent has a current answer or an open alert

stages.name: Eval
stages.given: the work, and a standard set beforehand
stages.hands_back: a graded judgment, with a reason on each grade
stages.done_when: every piece is graded, and the standard predates the work

stages.name: Incident response
stages.given: what monitoring saw, and the agent's records
stages.hands_back: a timeline of what's known, with every gap marked
stages.done_when: every fact names its source, and every gap is marked

stages.name: Cost
stages.given: the ceilings, and what each job spent
stages.hands_back: what was spent, by whom, against what was allowed
stages.done_when: every spend traces to a job, and the total reconciles

stages.name: Update
stages.given: a new package, and the agent it replaces
stages.hands_back: the same agent on the new version, with what changed recorded
stages.done_when: the candidate passed before the promote, and the identity and address are unchanged

stages.name: Reconfigure
stages.given: the running agent, and the change as names and numbers
stages.hands_back: the same agent on the same version, and a signed record of what changed
stages.done_when: the change is in place, no secret appeared, and the agent still answers

stages.name: Rollback
stages.given: the agent, and the version before
stages.hands_back: the agent back on that version, why, and what can't be undone
stages.done_when: it answers on the old version, and the side effects are named

stages.name: Decommission
stages.given: the instruction, and the agent
stages.hands_back: nothing running, the records kept, and the address retired
stages.done_when: no work is stranded, the records are kept, and the address is never reused
